predictions: Oh, heck yeah! Now last week was finally what a week should look like for me! I dropped a 21-6 record, and among my 6 losses were both of the week's tiebreakers and three 13-11s. Only the Machine win over Rippin really got me, and it all could so easily have been a near perfect week. Let's keep that up! All that brings me to 169-70 (70.7% correct) for the season, which is a pretty stout bar (and is currently climbing!).

Match of the week: (C Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Mulligans Mafia. The 2nd through 5th teams in C have each risen and fallen surprisingly several times, and now they sit just a single match apart, and with a likely climb to B division on the line. Not only is this pair in the thick of it, but they even went to 1001 last time. Let's take Menace in 1001 again!

Match #2: (G Div.) Banging the Wire @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Banging sits two matches ahead of anyone else in G despite surpassing 14 points only once since week 1. To say they haven't been locking wins down handily would be an understatement. Meanwhile, Throw It has scored 10+ in every match. This is going to be tight. Wire, 13-11.

Match #3: (B Div.) Angry Birds @ Why So Serious? The Birds took one on the chin last week, but they had been on fire for a month before that. So, Serious had better pay serious attention here. Heck, this one went to 1001 last time around, so it's definitely on tonight. Serious, 13-11.

Matches #4, #5 & #6: (F Div.) Cheap Shots @ That's What She Said; Shark Shooters @ Death Throw; Nein Mark @ Down to F, Again. I've said it too many times to count already… every single match in F could be the key outcome. And it's still super true. Only one of these pairs has teams separated by fewer than five spots in the standings, but I could still easily argue that any of these could win tonight (and could even win big). I think the Cheapies' DCkt edge will drive their win over She Said, 14-10. Death Throw absolutely refuses to just take a hold of a match and roll it, but I think they win in Death Throw style, 14-10 or closer. And I think Nein Mark has finally figured things out, 13-11.
Match #7: (G Div.) Aim-ing For Trouble @ Sharky's Machine. ANY of the 5 teams from 2nd through 6th in G could end up in H next season… or in F. Crazy good race. Machine grabs a 13-11 win.

Match #8: (C Div.) Area 501 @ Darty Little Secrets. This is about the last shot at there being a race in C. Or rather, a race for 1st. The race for 2nd will end up a great one. But Area is out of reach, 14-10.
Match #9: (G Div.) Cary On Our Wayward Darts @ Rippin Darts. Can a winless team take out a 2nd place team? Well, a month ago I didn't expect that Rippin could be facing losing 4 of 5. Rippin, 16-8.
Match #10: (D Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Shooter McGavin. There are five teams in D desperately fighting to not end up in the bottom-2 slots. And that race is glorious. Stumble moves up, 13-11.

Match #11: (C Div.) Pints and Points @ Brutha Ducks. If the last teams in C want to find a way to climb out of that pair, they'll have to reel in the Ducks. Pints get their shot. Alas, it'll be Ducks, 13-11.
Match #12: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Red-eye Rangers. These two are so much the middle of H that this could already be a preview of a tournament quarterfinal. Let's take Bright Side, 14-10.
